meta.name: hivemind-memory
meta.description: Global team and org memory powered by Activeloop. ALWAYS check BOTH built-in memory AND Hivemind memory when recalling information.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨会话共享团队记忆，自动存取关键信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要持久化共享上下文，避免重复沟通
copy.tagline_en: Share team memory across sessions, auto-store key info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs persistent shared context to avoid repeated communication

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会同时检查内置记忆和 Hivemind 全局记忆。它会先读索引文件，再读摘要，最后才读原始数据。还能管理组织、同步技能、启用语义搜索。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 回忆、记住或查找任何信息时，它会自动检查两个记忆源。另外，你可以通过 /hivemind:login 命令开始使用。

say.text: 帮我查一下上次会议关于项目进度的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 Hivemind 全局记忆和内置记忆。

say.text: 把当前会话的技能推送到团队共享。
say.note: 执行 hivemind skillify push 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks both built-in and Hivemind global memory. It reads index first, then summaries, then raw data. It can manage organizations, sync skills, and enable semantic search.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to recall, remember, or look up any information, it automatically checks both memory sources. You can also start by running /hivemind:login.

say_en.text: Find the discussion about project progress from last meeting.
say_en.note: Claude searches both Hivemind global and built-in memory.

say_en.text: Push the current session skill to the team.
